nodes.ui_description: This screen displays a music library with categorized tracks and provides a modal dialog for applying time-based filters to refine the track list view.
This modal dialog allows the user to export a playlist by selecting a destination folder and specifying a filename for the exported file, with the app's song list visible in the background.
This screen displays and manages the upcoming track queue in a music player, showing song details, album art, and allowing users to view, search, and reorder queued songs.
This screen displays search results for music queries, presenting a list of matching tracks with song titles, durations, and album art for users to browse and select for playback.

This screen displays detailed track listings for a selected album from music search results, allowing users to view album contents and initiate playback of specific tracks, with an active mini-player showing the currently selected song.
This screen displays a full-screen music player interface with playback controls, progress tracking, speed adjustment, and shows the current track's metadata along with the next song in queue.

This screen presents a categorized settings menu allowing users to customize the app's appearance through color themes, configure general behavior like language and tab management, and adjust audio playback preferences.
This modal dialog allows users to configure sorting criteria and order for music library items, presenting options for sorting by title or track count with ascending/descending toggles.

This screen allows users to select from various audio equalizer presets for different music genres or switch to custom mode for manual frequency adjustments, with the currently selected preset visually highlighted.
This screen is a media player interface with an active modal overlay that allows the user to adjust the playback speed of the current media item, which is currently set to normal speed (1.00x).
This screen allows users to customize audio output by adjusting five frequency band sliders (60 Hz to 14 kHz) with ±15 unit range and provides access to preset equalizer configurations.

This screen displays search results for the query 'hello world!' with a 'no items found' message and an option to create a new playlist, while showing the currently playing track in a bottom player bar.
This screen allows users to configure folder exclusions for audio file scanning, with explanatory text about how excluded folders affect library visibility versus manual playlist additions.
This dialog allows users to select a precise color through multiple methods including a gradient color field, hue spectrum slider, preset swatches, and hex code input before confirming their choice.
This screen allows users to select and customize colors through a gradient picker, hue slider, preset swatches, and hex code input, with live preview of the selected color.
This screen presents a dialog for selecting a folder from the device's internal storage, displaying each folder with an icon and item count to help users choose a directory for file operations.

This screen allows users to manage their music playlist by viewing track listings, adding songs or folders to the playlist, exporting the playlist to a file, and controlling active playback from a bottom bar.
This modal dialog allows users to create a new custom playlist by entering a title, with cancel and confirm options, while showing existing playlists and current playback in the background.

This screen allows users to personalize the app's visual appearance by selecting color options for theme, text, background, primary accents, and app icon through interactive color swatches and toggles.
